quotes.text: Sign In counts show who opened the apps. Copilot adoption means showing who actually used prompts and actions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A leadership-ready sound bite separating sign-in counts from real adoption.

quotes.text: Copilot adoption grows fastest where the tool reduces friction in small, repetitive tasks, think cleaning up an email, fixing awkward grammar, or smoothing a team's message before you hit send.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains where sticky Copilot usage actually comes from.

quotes.text: The bigger lesson is adoption isn't driven by potential, is driven by frequency and pain points.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Condenses the core adoption insight into one line.

quotes.text: If the same prompt category repeats weekly within a team, don't just log it, treat it as a signpost for a workflow change or automation candidate.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Turns prompt telemetry into a concrete improvement signal.

quotes.text: Treat every department the same and you waste budget. Focus where activity already thrives, and build tailored, practical on ramps for the groups holding back
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear recommendation for department-specific adoption campaigns.

Prompts: useful work or small talk

takeaways: Entra sign-in reports only count who opened an app, so prove Copilot adoption with Insights telemetry on prompts, app activity and departmental usage.
Copilot usage concentrates in Outlook, Teams and Word for small repetitive tasks, so focus training and success stories on the top apps by prompt count.
Separate recurring prompt categories from novelty spikes and give each low-adoption department a tailored remediation plan instead of generic training.
hook: Leadership waves a sign-in report and concludes Copilot is useless, but that chart only counts doors opened, not work done. This episode shows Microsoft 365 admins and adoption leads which telemetry really proves Copilot adoption and how to turn prompt and department data into a defensible ROI story.
